caption: The drawing depicts a circular design bordered with an orange-brown ring that encloses a man riding a horse. The man is drawn with a smiling face, wearing a brown hat, a green coat with brown vest, white shirt, green pants, and brown shoes. He holds a pair of scissors in one hand raised above his head, and a green object resembling combs or shears in his other hand. The horse, rendered in light beige and outlined in brown, is shown in profile, with its front and rear legs extended. Decorative green, blue, and brown floral patterns accompany the figures, with large blooms to the left and right, and additional smaller leaves and shapes filling the border. Encircling the inner edge of the ring is a line of cursive German text in orange-brown. The background both inside and outside the circle is a muted, off-white color. The artist’s signature, “E. H. Sellhall 1891,” is present below the circle, toward the bottom right.
title: Pa. German Plate
